prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish new screen changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests (+0.3% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, and sign_in hint changes, as each has only 1 test so far.
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as all tests so far resulted in no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high across tests, particularly for redesigns (predicted +12.0%, measured -3.4%) and new flows (predicted +2.0%, measured -4.6%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.3% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, hint] Story Screen Value Hint: Displays a reassuring hint on the initial story screen explaining that pet preferences can be customized or changed anytime after setup. (why: High mean completion time (514s) and 76.2% conversion at choose_path suggests hesitation during initial setup selection.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Intro Compact Layout Redesign: Redesigns the initial story screen into a compact layout with structured benefit cards to accelerate narrative progression. (why: The choose_path phase has a long mean time (514s), indicating users get stuck reading narrative text before making a path choice.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Account Persistence Clarification: Updates sign-in screen messaging to clearly state that signing in saves your pet cloud state and prevents progress resets across reinstalls. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing back in.)
3: [sign_in, wait_info] Sign-In Connection Progress Indicator: Adds a visual progress bar component and connection status message to the sign-in screen. (why: Support received bug reports regarding the sign-in screen stalling or failing to launch smoothly.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Generation Guidance Screen: Inserts a dedicated custom pet photo guidelines screen before uploading to ensure successful pet generation. (why: Support logged 3 emails where custom pet generation failed or produced broken visual results.)
5: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Grid View Layout: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to a grid layout to make comparing pet options faster and easier. (why: Adoption stage is the biggest bottleneck with only 60.9% conversion and a mean duration of 1017 seconds.)
6: [home, wait_info] Pet Spawn Status Progress Visualizer: Enables progress indicators and desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: Support received 3 emails where pets failed to appear on the desktop or the app stalled during home initialization.)
7: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Interaction Guide Copy: Updates the home_intro copy to explain basic desktop actions such as clicking to interact and right-clicking to manage overlay settings. (why: Finish step dropoff is 64.8% and support reported confusion on controlling or hiding pets post-setup.)

scores.note: Config-only hint for long completion time; modest impact potential.
Redesigns have historically performed poorly; high effort.
Strong support evidence (8 emails) and low cost text change.
Addresses sign-in stalling bug reports and step drop-off.
Targeting high-dropoff step, but adding a new screen risks worsening completion.
Adoption is the largest bottleneck step with longest mean time.
Backed by support complaints, but Home stage already has high conversion.
Low cost copy fix directly addressing reported post-setup confusion on finish step.
